reason: In packages/app-store/googlecalendar/lib/CalendarService.ts:100-124 (createEvent) and 198-230 (updateEvent), the organizer email is always taken from destinationCalendar[0].externalId. createEvent runs once per host's calendar (EventManager createAllCalendarEvents loop), and only the target calendarId changes per credentialId, so every host's Google event gets the main host's calendar as organizer email.
